entries.test: Public demonstrations and independent evaluations of machines that reliably assist critical reasoning, reduce human bias, and provide factual answers without confabulation would establish the predicted capability.
entries.note: This is a firm prediction with no deadline; continued absence alone cannot settle it as false.

entries.test: Independent comparisons of machine and human performance across diverse reasoning and information-synthesis tasks would establish whether machines achieve more reliable reasoning and substantially better synthesis.
entries.note: The parenthetical describes existing limited successes; it is not a condition on the forecast.

entries.test: Public capability evaluations available by November 25, 2023, research documenting the relevant technical limitations, and contemporary claims about those capabilities would test the stated shortfall and confusion.
entries.note: The principal assertion concerns capabilities at publication, with an accompanying causal explanation about limited AI knowledge.
“Probably” explicitly hedges the proposed benefit. Thinking about human minds is the antecedent; “probably” is not a condition.
